blocks: ## T03 - the prose and the placeholders (FR-003, FR-004)
## T04 - measure and land (FR-006, SC-001 - SC-004)

decisions.summary: Delete the 71 exhibit-only names plus their transitive closure (166 names), to a fixpoint, and the twelve modules that empty
decisions.why: The request is to delete code only frozen maps reach, to cut the support surface; a name reached only by the 71 is likewise reached only by frozen maps, and FR-001 names (1) and (2) as the list. The fixpoint deletes nothing a live reference reaches.

decisions.summary: A name reached through a string (getattr, dispatch/caption table, roster) is KEPT if live code reaches it, the row recorded in the plan
decisions.why: FR-001 states this carve-out itself; a name live code reaches is outside the request's 'called only by frozen maps' set, so keeping it narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: Mixin modules deleted with their base and import dropped from the package composition; unused imports and re-exports removed; duplicate-spelled names checked by hand
decisions.why: Mechanics of FR-001 ('a module left with no member goes whole, with its mixin from its composition').

decisions.summary: make dead-closure must show nothing NEWLY DEAD, no PINNED, STILL CALLED only frozen exhibits or a recorded false alarm
decisions.why: Restates SC-002; the false-alarm allowance is for same-spelled locals, which are not the deleted names.

decisions.summary: Tests whose subject is deleted go; mixed tests keep the live part; emptied directories and their Makefile references (QUICK_TREE, gate trees) go; lines only deleted tests covered are deleted if nothing live reaches them, else a test is owed
decisions.why: FR-002 verbatim in substance; the coverage-floor rule deletes only code no live path reaches (the request's own target) and otherwise adds a test that enforces the live behavior.

decisions.summary: Repoint CLAUDE.md indexes, docstrings, docs/ and dev/ (incl. migration-plan rows); claims index updated by its targets; 380/381/382 each gain one pointer line to the commit before the deletion
decisions.why: FR-003 and FR-004 as written; the request's own cost statement is that 381/382 'recover them from git', which the pointer line serves.

decisions.summary: No single-artifact target; make maps over the whole live pool and the landing cohort stand in for reference-then-pool since nothing is meant to move
decisions.why: FR-006/SC-003 set exactly this proof; the plan widens rather than narrows verification of 'no live map changes'.

decisions.summary: Start/end performance bookends, make maps, make done, cohort-landing, feature report, gated push
decisions.why: Process for landing; the GM asked to file and execute the feature.

decisions.summary: Touched set: settlement/**, waterfields/hill.py, citybudget.py, tests/**, docs/, dev/, specs 380-382, claims index; nothing under the legacy pool
decisions.why: Matches FR-001 to FR-005; the frozen legacy maps (FR-005) are not in the touched set.
